sloka: रामस्य वचनं श्रुत्वा भरत: प्रत्युवाच ह ।किं मे धर्माद्विहीनस्य राजधर्म: करिष्यति ॥ २.१०१.१॥
transliteration: rāmasya vacanaṁ śrutvā bharata: pratyuvāca ha ।kiṁ me dharmādvihīnasya rājadharma: kariṣyati ॥ 2.101.1॥

translations.english: On listening to Rama, Bharata replied Of what use shall be these royal duties to me, when I have fallen from righteousness?
